lci.text: The Core is the sealed world-within-the-world of Ixalan, where the Oltec retreated to safeguard their knowledge and cosmium, and which the Deep Gods sealed behind golden gates guarded by angels.
Under siege from the Mycotyrant, the Oltec sealed it off from the world until Huatli's party arrived, and the Malamet and Oltec found a common enemy in the mycoids and began sharing glyph knowledge.

Amalia and Kellan stepped through the golden door into the hollow world matching her visions, where Anim explained that the Komon were Oltec ancestors who had left the Core, and where Vito and the Legion of Dusk imprisoned worshippers of the Great Betrayer.

Vito opened the door with a pink crystal key and found Aclazotz chained, who broke his chains, transformed the vampires into bat creatures and plunged the Core into darkness by closing dark shards around Chimil.
